notes.title: The Last Nordic Tribe at the February Steam Fest!
notes.content:
[h2]Video Coming to Steam Next Fest February 24.[/h2]
[h3]We announce that Steam has invited us to participate in February's festival of demos, known as Steam Fest. 
Of course we accepted the invitation and are entering our demo and gameplay for this great event!
We invite all interested parties to participate.
The event will start on the 24th of February![/h3]
